REPO_PURPOSE: Source-driven lab operations and compliance tracker for MiSalud's lab launch. Markdown and CSV files are the editable source of truth, release artifacts are built to Google Drive, and compliance workflows must preserve version history, changelogs, and change reports.
REPO_DOCS: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, README-setup.md, compliance/README.md, execution/task_board.csv, .scripts/lib/bilateral-sync.ts, .codex/hooks/pre-edit-sync-check.sh, .claude/hooks/pre-edit-sync-check.sh
REPO_LAYOUT: execution/ holds sprint plans, task board, and stakeholder material. regulatory/, procurement/, staffing/, compliance/, location/, operations/, commercial/, and product-integration/ hold source documents. build/ contains release tooling. .scripts/ contains TypeScript automation for sync, graph, reports, Gmail, Plane, and governance. templates/ contains folder templates. .claude/ and .codex/ contain provider-specific adapters and hooks.
REPO_LOCAL_CONVENTIONS: Edit Markdown and CSV sources, not generated release artifacts. Compliance changes must preserve changelogs and change reports. Compliance reverse-sync routes through doc-control. Build outputs go to Google Drive. The LIS/device integration work belongs in misalud-lab-lis, not this tracker.
DEFAULT_COMMANDS:
- Script tests: `cd .scripts && npm test`
- List release sources: `make list`
- Build release only with approval: `make release`
- Dashboard only with approval: `make dashboard`
- Serve dashboard only with approval: `make serve`
EXTERNAL_WRITE_OPERATIONS: Google Drive release writes, Plane sync writes, Gmail sends, Google Sheets writes, Supabase/Neon writes, browser automation against third-party systems, Slack sync writes, doc-control reverse-sync writes, release artifact generation, dashboard/graph generation, and compliance document-control changes.
PRODUCTION_DATA_PATH_RULE: Treat compliance source files, release artifacts, Google Drive symlinks, task board data, procurement tracker data, and external-system sync state as production project records. Do not update release outputs, compliance controlled docs, Drive artifacts, Plane, Gmail, Google Sheets, Supabase, or Neon without explicit approval.
CONFIG_CHANGE_RULE: Do not change bilateral sync hooks, build release paths, Google Drive release paths, compliance document-control routing, provider settings, MCP config, Plane config, or auth token handling without reading the current docs and getting explicit approval.
PERMISSION_BOUNDARY_RULE: Do not add broad shell permissions, new remote automation, CI, deploy keys, mirrors, repo-read integrations, or provider-equivalent broad permissions without explicit approval and security review.
DEFAULT_READ_SCOPE: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.codex/hooks/pre-edit-sync-check.sh`, `.scripts/` source and tests excluding generated dependencies and credentials, and relevant source docs under content folders
EXCLUDED_PATHS: `.claude/.env.local`, `.claude/.gmail-token.json`, `.claude/.scan-state.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.claude/tmp/`, `node_modules/`, `.scripts/node_modules/`, release directories, binary outputs, `.build-state.json`, `.playwright-mcp/`, `.tmp/`, Google Drive symlink targets unless explicitly needed
BASELINE_COMMANDS:
- Unit tests: `cd .scripts && npm test`
- Release source list: `make list`
- Targeted TypeScript test: `cd .scripts && npx vitest run lib/<test-file>.test.ts`
SAFETY_TESTS: `cd .scripts && npm test`, bilateral sync checks for touched source files, and doc-control validation for compliance file changes.
SESSION_COMPACTION_RULE: Past roughly 40-50 tool calls, or once a thread of work concludes, proactively suggest compaction. Use bounded file lists and targeted docs instead of loading generated dependencies, release artifacts, or Google Drive symlink targets.
HOOK_STATE: Tracked Codex and Claude pre-edit hooks enforce bilateral sync checks for content sources. Compliance paths cannot be bypassed. Existing `.claude/` and `.codex/` adapters must not be overwritten blindly.
OBJECTIVE: Normalize tracker agent policy by adding a provider-neutral `.agent/` policy pack and carefully updating existing adapters after approval.
BRANCH: To be created in a separate approved worktree after the dirty main checkout is resolved.
DIRTY_FILES: Main checkout has existing modified compliance, scripts, templates, and plan files plus untracked plan/change-report files. Preserve all existing work.
FILES_ALLOWED: Recommended first copy: `.agent/` only. Updating `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `.codex/` should be a separate reviewed adapter-normalization step.
DIRECTORIES_ALLOWED: .agent/ only for first copy unless adapter edits are explicitly approved.
FILES_OFF_LIMITS: Existing dirty files, `.claude/`, `.codex/`, credentials, local state, generated release outputs, binaries, Google Drive symlink targets, node_modules, and compliance controlled docs unless explicitly approved.
EXTERNAL_SYSTEMS_ALLOWED: None during scaffold planning or copy.
SENSITIVE_DATA_RISK: High. The repo contains compliance materials, project records, release artifacts, external-system state, and Google Drive-linked references.
CREDENTIAL_RISK: High. `.claude/` contains local credentials and state files; do not read or print credential values.
PRODUCTION_WRITE_RISK: High. Release, sync, email, Plane, Google Sheets, Supabase, Neon, browser automation, and document-control commands can affect live project records or external systems.
HARDWARE_RISK: Low for this repo. Device and LIS work should route to misalud-lab-lis.
AUTOMATION_RISK: High if provider settings, hooks, MCP configs, sync scripts, release tooling, CI, remotes, deploy keys, mirrors, or repo-read integrations are changed.
TASK_SPECIFIC_DOCS: docs/audits/2026-08-14-misalud-lab-tracker.md and docs/rollout-checklist.md from the global agent-dev-system project.
PLAN: Render the scaffold into staging, inspect it, wait for a clean worktree approval, copy `.agent/` first, then separately review adapter normalization for existing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .codex/ files.
VALIDATION_COMMANDS:
git status --short --branch
python3 <path-to-global-agent-dev-system>/scripts/check_scaffold.py <target-repo>
cd .scripts && npm test
EXPECTED_EVIDENCE: Existing dirty work untouched; scaffold check passes after approved copy; bilateral sync hooks remain intact; no release, Drive, Plane, Gmail, Google Sheets, Supabase, Neon, browser, or doc-control write occurred.
APPROVAL_BEFORE_EXTERNAL_WRITES: Required, and no external writes are expected.
